hook: A 25-minute paper-strip test detects RNA of the 2026 Bundibugyo Ebola strain
summary: Researchers designed isothermal amplification primers for the 2026 Bundibugyo virus strain and read the result on a lateral flow strip. The primers reacted only with the target RNA, not with other filoviruses, arboviruses or human cells, and worked down to 10^3 copies per reaction. Testing used synthetic RNA and viral RNA in the lab, not patient samples, so real-world accuracy is unknown.
title: Reverse Transcription Loop-Mediated Isothermal Amplification Combined with Lateral Flow Assay (RT-LAMP-LFA) for Rapid Detection of the 2026 Bundibugyo Virus (BDBV) Outbreak Strain
